associations.rationale: The theorem directly gives the multiplicity-free decomposition component of R1, but it does not itself state the accompanying classification of all one-dimensional representations required by the complete source claim.
This defines the abelianization map used to construct the one-dimensional representations, rather than classifying or decomposing them itself.
The kernel containment is a helper showing that a one-dimensional character factors through the abelian quotient.
Surjectivity of the abelianization map is a prerequisite for the classification equivalence.
The equivalence gives the one-dimensional-representation classification component, but it does not itself state the required multiplicity-free decomposition of R1.
This application formula explains the construction underlying the classification equivalence but is not itself the classification.
The cardinality p^2 is a consequence of the one-dimensional classification, not the classification or R1 decomposition itself.
